purpose: Deterministic, editable texture sources for Photoshop, Remotion, HyperFrames, and local HTML composition. They provide atmosphere behind exact typography; they are not campaign plates or finished ads.

production_boundary.current_assets: Local procedural SVG source files only. No provider, model, key, credits, or paid generation were used.
production_boundary.external_variants: An external texture candidate may be proposed only in an approved asset-graph job. It must have a human brief, cost receipt, source/output hashes, task-specific QA, and a human decision before use.
production_boundary.text_rule: Textures contain no text, logo, person, or factual claim. Exact typography is composed later.

usage.default: Use as a low-opacity background layer. Preserve enough quiet field for readable type and never let the texture become the subject.
usage.safe_starting_opacity: 8-18%, then inspect at the intended export size.
do_not: Treat a texture as a blog hero or a visual argument on its own.
Use the FAMtastic black/lime texture as a default for a subject-specific campaign.
Bake headline, CTA, price, or URL into any texture.

assets.visual_role: Sober document, ownership, credibility, and LinkedIn surfaces.
assets.composition: Warm off-white field, subtle paper fibre and a tiny deep-green ink incident at the lower edge.
Dark dusty earth field with one muted amber wash, faint grain, and no object or signage.

assets.visual_role: Personal-service, care, and close human-work surfaces.
assets.composition: Deep plum field, gentle dusty-rose practical glow, and fine soft grain.

assets.visual_role: Repair, work, field service, and industrial-process surfaces.
assets.composition: Blue-black steel ground with restrained safety-orange edge light and worn diagonal scratch marks.

assets.visual_role: FAMtastic offer and system surfaces only.
assets.composition: Near-black field, quiet architectural grid, and one constrained lime edge accent.
